ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to transition assistance or to get our Customer Data back on exit. This follows our position of up to six months' assistance at your then-current rates, machine-readable data return within thirty days, and certified deletion afterwards; we can discuss a shorter assistance period if needed.
input.summary: Insert new Section 10.3 requiring transition assistance, machine-readable Customer Data return within 30 days, and certified deletion.
